name: dsh-branchmark-workspace
description: Excerpt-driven session branching and conversation lineage for DeepSeek Harness
author: zaizaizhao

scripts.build: pnpm run build:host && pnpm run build:client && pnpm run build:bundle
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build:host && pnpm --recursive --if-present run typecheck
scripts.check: pnpm run verify:brand && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run build && pnpm run verify:bundle
scripts.pack:bundle: pnpm run build:bundle && pnpm --dir packages/bundle pack --pack-destination ../../dist
scripts.release:check: pnpm run check && pnpm run verify:docs && pnpm run verify:release && pnpm exec publint packages/bundle && pnpm --dir packages/bundle publish --dry-run --access public --no-git-checks
